name: flutter
description: Flutter + Dart + Riverpod + go_router + Dio. Draws native iOS and Android UI from one codebase.

notes.platformBoundary: Tokens go in flutter_secure_storage (Keychain · Keystore) — shared_preferences is plaintext. Platform features are called through plugins or platform channels, and permissions are declared in Info.plist · AndroidManifest
notes.toolchain: **The toolchain splits from the web frontend and the backend** (pub ↔ npm). Shared types are generated from a language-neutral contract such as OpenAPI
notes.release: Store review is the only release path (no code push). Old app versions keep running, so API version negotiation is required
